summary: Hawkeye Systems, Inc. filed an 8-K on Items 5.02, 7.01, and 8.01 reporting that, as previously disclosed, the Board had conditionally appointed four directors (Martin Sumichrast, Sim Farar, Nathan Bradley Fleisher, and Ralph Olson) under a Schedule 14f-1 filed April 16, 2026. The appointments became effective May 4, 2026. No dollar terms, premium, adviser, or board recommendation are disclosed. The mechanic is a board co-opting via a 14f-1 information statement; there is no shareholder vote. Watch for any dissident or activist background among the appointees—Sumichrast has a history of leading cbdMD and SPACs—and potential future strategic shifts.
